title: VR Golf '97
overview:
It's just a game like the Green Jacket is just a sports coat. Say hello to the next generation of golf. We're talking real-time 3-D Virtual FieldVision that lets you play any lie on the course from any perspective. It's interactive technology that doesn't just look better, it plays better. Plus, the fast course set-up between shots means there's no waiting on this course. So gauge your distance, select your club, pick your direction and park a 300-yard drive down the middle of the fairway. Play amateur and professional tours or play up to three of your friends at the same time.

VR Golf '97. The Difference Is Real.

Product Features:
- Virtual FieldVision
- Fast course set-up between shots
- Interactive Motion Capture
- Realistic 3-D polygon figures and courses
- Easy play format with on-screen interface for fades, draws and other vital shot tactics
- Amateur and professional tours
- Fully customized golfers
- Customized club selection
- Save/Load game option
- Multiplayer option
- Shot tracking
- Instant replay from any camera angle
- Mulligans
- 3 live commentary options with Pat O'Brien and Peter Alliss
